about.title: Connecting The World
about.heading: Get to know us
about.copy1: We began our operations in 1995 as an ocean consolidator in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Since then, we have expanded our presence to 40 offices across 13 countries in South America, the Nordic countries (Norway and Sweden) and the United States.
about.copy2: Market developments and our customers’ needs led us to expand our services and evolve toward a more comprehensive business model. Today we are a Neutral Logistics Operator (NLO): we offer multiple logistics solutions and have established ourselves as a strategic partner that supports every stage of the operation.
about.copy3: We are part of MSL Group, a multinational business group that brings together leading brands in the logistics sector. Under one shared vision and purpose, we form a global logistics network with a presence in the Americas, Europe, Africa, Southeast Asia and Oceania.

network.heading: MSL offices worldwide
network.description: Operations throughout South America, the United States and the Nordic countries, driving growth and connection between markets.

latam.label: LATAM
latam.details: We began operations as a neutral ocean consolidator, and subsequently expanded our range of services to become an NLO.

usa.label: USA
usa.details: Originally, IFS (a Spanish brand) expanded to the USA in 1995. Later, in 2007, an alliance between MSL and IFS was created, marking the start of our expansion in the US market. In 2025, IFS Miami became MSL USA, with a current presence in Los Angeles, Chicago, Miami and New York.

nordic.label: Nordic
nordic.details: Founded in 2008, LT Group established itself as a leading company in maritime and logistics services in Northern Europe. In 2025, it was acquired by MSL Group, giving rise to MSL Nordic: the first NLO in Scandinavia, combining regional experience with the group's global network.
